candidates.name: Central Nervous System Lymphoma
support_spans: Diffuse leptomeningeal enhancement
Enhancement of several cranial nerves including bilateral vagus nerves
Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed: Lymphocytosis with plasmacytoid features on light microscopy
Flow cytometry showed κ light chain–restricted B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
candidates.why: The combination of leptomeningeal enhancement, cranial nerve enhancement, and cerebrospinal fluid lymphocytosis with plasmacytoid features is highly suggestive of Central Nervous System Lymphoma.

candidates.name: Central nervous system lymphoma

Lymphocytosis with plasmacytoid features on light microscopy

candidates.name: Neurolymphomatosis
support_spans: Enhancement of several cranial nerves including bilateral vagus nerves
Nodular enhancement involving cisternal segments of bilateral glossopharyngeal and vagus nerves
Intraparenchymal ventral medullary enhancement
candidates.why: The patient's imaging studies show enhancement of multiple cranial nerves and leptomeningeal enhancement, which is consistent with neurolymphomatosis.

candidates.name: Richter's transformation
support_spans: Past medical history included fatigue several years prior, when he received chemotherapy (rituximab, cyclophosphamide, vincristine, and prednisone) followed by autologous peripheral blood stem cell transplant
Flow cytometry showed κ light chain–restricted B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
candidates.why: The patient's history of chemotherapy and stem cell transplant, combined with the presence of κ light chain–restricted B-cell lymphoma, suggests the possibility of Richter's transformation.

candidates.name: Neurolymphomatosis
support_spans: Enhancement of several cranial nerves including bilateral vagus nerves
Nodular enhancement involving cisternal segments of bilateral glossopharyngeal and vagus nerves, right hypoglossal nerve, intraparenchymal ventral medullary enhancement
candidates.why: The patient's imaging studies show enhancement of multiple cranial nerves, which is consistent with neurolymphomatosis, a rare condition characterized by lymphoma infiltration of the peripheral nervous system.

selector.rationale: Diffuse leptomeningeal enhancement and cerebrospinal fluid analysis showing lymphocytosis with plasmacytoid features support CNS Lymphoma, with neurolymphomatosis being a close second due to enhancement of cranial nerves

rejected.label: Richter's transformation
rejected.why: While past medical history and chemotherapy are relevant, the specific findings of leptomeningeal enhancement and cerebrospinal fluid lymphocytosis are more directly explained by CNS Lymphoma
